intro: The Premier League returns for 2026/27 with the same brutal format — 20 clubs, 38 rounds, no playoffs, three straight down — and the deepest betting markets in world football. Every fixture on this page carries our model's probabilities next to the best available prices, refreshed twice a day as lines move.

England's top flight is the most efficiently priced league we track, which cuts both ways: edges are rare, but the market depth means the prices you see are honest and the value of line shopping is measurable. Our model treats the Premier League with two seasons of weighted scoring rates per club, updated after every round below.
outlook: Title, top-four and relegation races priced week by week in our daily feed
The most liquid 1X2, totals and BTTS markets of any league we cover
Model ratings carry over with time decay — early-season picks lean on the market blend until new results accumulate

faq.q: When does the Premier League 2026/27 season run?
faq.a: The league season runs from August 2026 to May 2027 across 38 rounds. Exact kickoff dates and times for upcoming fixtures appear in the live feed on this page as soon as bookmakers price them.

faq.q: Do you post predictions for every Premier League match?
faq.a: Every fixture gets a model probability and a page; an official pick is only issued when the blended model-market probability clears the best price by a meaningful margin. Most matches produce a lean, not a pick — that restraint is deliberate.

faq.q: How accurate is the model in the Premier League?
faq.a: Top-flight markets are sharp, so our edge here is smaller than in secondary leagues. We publish the full settled record and closing-line value for every pick — check the results pages rather than trusting any headline accuracy claim, ours included.

intro: The EFL Championship's 2026/27 marathon: 24 clubs, 46 rounds each, plus playoffs — the longest league grind in top-level European football and one of the most volatile to price. Draw rates run high, squads rotate hard through midweek rounds, and promotion favourites routinely stumble at Tuesday-night away games.

That volatility is why we track it: bookmaker margins on Championship matches run wider than Premier League ones, and model-market disagreements appear more often. All 46 rounds flow through the feed below with model probabilities against best prices.
outlook: 46 rounds plus midweek congestion — squad rotation makes recent-form signals noisier than usual
Higher draw rates than the top flight; our model prices the draw explicitly
Wider margins than the Premier League mean line shopping matters even more here

faq.q: When does the Championship 2026/27 season run?
faq.a: From August 2026 to May 2027 — 46 league rounds per club, with the promotion playoffs following in late May. Upcoming priced fixtures appear in the live feed on this page.

faq.q: Why is the Championship considered hard to predict?
faq.a: Deep squads, constant midweek fixtures and small quality gaps between mid-table clubs produce high variance and one of Europe's highest draw rates. Models help most as a discipline against overreacting to short streaks.

faq.q: Do you cover Championship totals and BTTS?
faq.a: Yes — every tracked fixture carries 1X2 and totals probabilities, and BTTS picks appear in the tips feed when the price diverges from the model's fair odds.

intro: La Liga 2026/27: 20 clubs, 38 rounds, and the tactical, lower-scoring profile that makes Spain a distinct betting market — league goal averages typically sit below England's and Germany's, which shifts value toward unders and tighter scorelines in our model's pricing.

Spain also produces sharp home-away splits and a long tail of draw-heavy mid-table fixtures. Our per-team scoring rates capture those patterns; the feed below shows every priced fixture with the model's view against the market.
outlook: Structurally lower goal averages than other top-five leagues — totals lines open lower and move less
Pronounced home advantage patterns at several grounds our per-team rates pick up
Big-club fixtures are sharply priced; better model-market gaps live in the mid-table

faq.q: When does La Liga 2026/27 run?
faq.a: August 2026 to May 2027, 38 rounds. Priced upcoming fixtures with model probabilities appear in the live feed on this page as bookmakers publish odds.

faq.q: Is La Liga really lower-scoring than other leagues?
faq.a: Historically yes — Spanish top-flight goal averages typically run below the Premier League and Bundesliga. Our league predictability research recomputes those averages from current data on every site rebuild.

faq.q: Where is the value in La Liga betting?
faq.a: Big-club matches are efficiently priced. The model finds more frequent disagreements in mid-table fixtures, draw pricing and unders — always small edges, published with full settlement records.

intro: Serie A 2026/27 brings 20 clubs and 38 rounds of the most tactically varied football in Europe — a league where coaching systems shift match profiles sharply enough that team scoring rates move more season-to-season than in England or Spain.

For bettors that means Italy rewards model discipline early: our time-decayed rates adapt as new patterns emerge, and the market blend guards against overcommitting to last season's identity. Every priced fixture runs through the feed below.
outlook: Coaching changes reshape team profiles faster than in most leagues — early rounds carry extra uncertainty
Historically strong home-advantage and draw dynamics in mid-table fixtures
Totals profiles vary widely between clubs; per-team rates matter more than league averages

faq.q: When does Serie A 2026/27 run?
faq.a: August 2026 to May 2027 across 38 rounds. Upcoming fixtures appear in the live feed on this page once bookmakers price them.

faq.q: Why does Serie A change character between seasons?
faq.a: Italian clubs change coaches and systems frequently, and tactical identity drives scoring profiles. Our model's time decay (recent matches weigh more) is built for exactly this kind of drift.

faq.q: Do you track Serie A totals?
faq.a: Yes — every fixture carries totals probabilities alongside 1X2, and over/under picks surface when live prices diverge from the model's fair odds.

intro: The Bundesliga's 2026/27 campaign: 18 clubs, 34 rounds, and reliably the highest-scoring profile of Europe's top leagues — a structural fact that shapes every totals line in Germany. Pressing football, big pitches and attacking depth keep goal averages up year after year.

Our model prices that aggression per team rather than by reputation, which matters in a league where promoted sides and Europa-chasing mid-table clubs often carry wildly different defensive profiles. All 34 rounds flow through the live feed below.
outlook: Europe's highest top-league goal averages — overs and BTTS base rates start elevated
Only 18 clubs and 34 rounds: every fixture carries more table weight than in 20-team leagues
The 16th-place relegation playoff adds a distinct late-season pricing dynamic

faq.q: When does the Bundesliga 2026/27 season run?
faq.a: August 2026 to May 2027 — 34 rounds for each of the 18 clubs, with the relegation playoff following. Priced fixtures appear in the live feed on this page.

faq.q: Is the Bundesliga really the highest-scoring big league?
faq.a: It has historically topped the top-five leagues for goals per match, and our live league-predictability research recomputes the current figure on every rebuild. Structurally high pressing and attacking styles sustain it.

faq.q: How does the 34-round format affect betting?
faq.a: Fewer rounds mean each result moves the table more, so late-season motivational spots (Europe, relegation) arrive earlier and hit prices harder. The model stays motivation-blind — we flag that honestly as a known limit.

intro: Ligue 1 2026/27: 18 clubs and 34 rounds of France's top flight — a league defined by a steep quality gradient from the continental contenders down to a tightly packed lower half, which produces short favourite prices at the top and genuinely competitive markets everywhere else.

That gradient is a modelling feature: heavy favourites are usually priced efficiently, while the compressed mid-table generates the drawish, low-margin-of-error fixtures where model-market gaps appear. Every priced match runs through the feed below.
outlook: Steep quality gradient: short-priced favourites at the top, coin-flip fixtures below
18 clubs / 34 rounds — the same higher-stakes-per-match dynamic as Germany
Compressed lower half historically produces elevated draw rates our model prices explicitly

faq.q: When does Ligue 1 2026/27 run?
faq.a: August 2026 to May 2027 across 34 rounds. Upcoming priced fixtures appear in this page's live feed as bookmakers publish odds.

faq.q: Is betting on heavy Ligue 1 favourites profitable?
faq.a: Short prices on dominant clubs are usually efficient — the market knows they win often. Our value screener more commonly flags mid-table totals and draw prices, where attention is thinner.

faq.q: Do you cover Ligue 1 relegation-zone matches?
faq.a: Every tracked fixture gets model probabilities regardless of table position. Late-season motivation is not in the model — we say so openly — which is worth remembering for May fixtures.

intro: The Eredivisie's 2026/27 season: 18 clubs, 34 rounds and Dutch football's standing commitment to attack — goal averages here routinely rival or beat any major European league, which raises the baseline for every totals and BTTS market in the country.

The top-club gradient is steep, but the league's real betting character lives in its open mid-table games. Our per-team scoring rates track exactly that openness; the live feed below carries every priced fixture.
outlook: Among Europe's highest league goal averages — totals baselines start high
Steep gap from the traditional top clubs to the rest shapes handicap markets
European playoff spots keep mid-table motivation alive deep into spring

faq.q: When does the Eredivisie 2026/27 season run?
faq.a: August 2026 to May 2027, 34 rounds, followed by European-qualification playoffs. Priced fixtures appear in the live feed on this page.

faq.q: Why is the Eredivisie popular for overs betting?
faq.a: Structurally attacking football keeps goals per match high year after year, so over 2.5 lands more often than in most leagues — and bookmakers price that in. Value needs a per-team view, not the league stereotype.

faq.q: Do you model the Eredivisie top clubs differently?
faq.a: No special-casing — the same time-decayed scoring rates apply to every club. The data itself encodes the gradient, which keeps the methodology honest and inspectable.

intro: Portugal's Primeira Liga 2026/27: 18 clubs, 34 rounds, and one of Europe's most top-heavy competitions — the traditional big three have shared almost every title, which makes outright markets narrow but match-level pricing rich, especially when the giants visit compact defensive sides.

Big-club away games against low blocks are a classic totals battleground here. Our model prices each club's actual scoring and conceding rates rather than reputation; every priced fixture flows through the feed below.
outlook: Extremely top-heavy title picture; the interest is in match markets, not outrights
Defensive lower-half sides create distinctive unders profiles against the giants
European qualification races keep the sub-elite tier competitive all season

faq.q: When does the Primeira Liga 2026/27 season run?
faq.a: August 2026 to May 2027 across 34 rounds. Upcoming priced fixtures appear in the live feed on this page.

faq.q: Is there value betting against the big three?
faq.a: Rarely on the 1X2 — their win rates are priced short and fairly. Model-market gaps show up more often on totals and handicaps in those fixtures, where the defensive profile of the opponent matters more than the headline mismatch.

faq.q: Do you cover Primeira Liga BTTS markets?
faq.a: Yes — BTTS probabilities are derived from each side's scoring and clean-sheet rates, and picks appear in the tips feed when prices drift from the model's fair odds.

intro: The Brasileirão Série A 2026 runs on the calendar year — 20 clubs, 38 rounds from autumn to December — and is already deep into its schedule. Squad turnover mid-season, continental fixtures and enormous travel distances make Brazil one of the most demanding leagues to price anywhere.

It is also one of the least efficiently priced markets we track from Europe-facing bookmakers, which is exactly why it earns a place in the feed. Our model runs on our own accumulated results archive for Brazil; every priced fixture appears below.
outlook: Calendar-year season — live now, with rounds through December 2026
Continental cup congestion and travel create rotation-driven volatility
European bookmakers price Brazil less sharply than domestic markets — margins run wider

faq.q: When does the Brasileirão 2026 season run?
faq.a: The Série A season runs across the 2026 calendar year, finishing in December — it is in progress now, and every upcoming priced round appears in this page's live feed.

faq.q: Why is the Brasileirão hard to model?
faq.a: Mid-season transfers to Europe, continental competition congestion and huge travel swings make team strength less stable than in European leagues. Our time-decayed rates adapt, but we treat Brazil edges with extra humility.

faq.q: Are Brasileirão odds worse than European league odds?
faq.a: Margins at Europe-facing bookmakers tend to run wider on Brazil than on the Premier League, which cuts value — but pricing errors are also more common. Line shopping matters doubly here.
